reviews.title: This app I used to have no problems with
reviews.text:
This app, for whatever reason, just will not load up no more. You can’t save them. I’m driving around in the city and it acts like it’s got bad service or something, but it’s been awful you gotta save your estimate offline now. 

But whoever is in the design of it either added too much, it’s just taken too long to but something’s definitely wrong. Maybe they need to make two apps, I don’t know, but something is jacked up and it’s very annoying when you’re trying to run a business. I don’t think they care any anymore because they got everybody’s money

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Definitely not free

reviews.title: Unable to Zoom in on iPhone anymore
reviews.text: Used to be able to zoom in when reviewing estimates on iPhone but since the update last year can not zoom in anymore making it really difficult to read and impossible to show photos to clients on the spot.  Please fix, thanks

reviews.title: Love the app but…..
reviews.text:
Every time there’s an update, something is taken away.  It started with the monetization, which I understand. Then the limit on quantity of invoices… then the sample logo pinch…… now there’s an increase in subscription fee… it’s pricing me out of the app.  I love the app, but can’t justify paying for it to only be able to have 5 sales per month- and now with the latest price increase.. if I can create more invoices per month, I’d maybe be willing to pay the extra. But for now, I’m looking for a switch. What a shame.  I’m so disappointed. Also you used to be able to pause the charges which worked for me during winter …not anymore. 
Wish I wasn’t done, but I can’t justify the cost anymore.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: This app went from free to ridiculous price in a very short span. After I cancelled the subscription, that I paid for, I was unable to access or view the invoices and bids I had already paid for. This app did more harm than good

reviews.title: Unhelpful
reviews.text: Used these for a few year on a paid subscription. You don’t get enough invoices and quotes for the cost. Once you finish subscription they are poor at helping you get your required information downloaded. Stay clear better available for cheaper.

reviews.title: No auto save and staff under educated on how it works
reviews.text:
I loose work when working on a document sometimes. The  program freezes 
I loose the work since there is no auto save. I have sent my concerned numerous times but some staffers are not educated on the program to provide help. 

Fix these issues and the ap works great otherwise.

Customer service in reference to providing accurate clear instructions to resolve issues is very much lacking.

reviews.title: App failed
reviews.text: Make sure to back everything up. The app failed to work for me and support isn’t helpful. Don’t get caught off guard!

reviews.text: Don’t use these people they expect you to have a subscription to get your data once you stop using their service. It’s in other words for stealing business information from you. It use to be free

reviews.title: They will try to run your business for you!
reviews.text: Omg this is by far the most annoying app I have ever used! The app itself is fine, but the company won’t leave you alone! Constant messages and emails with ideas and suggestions on how to use the app and get more business! Yes, that’s right! Joust thinks they know more about your business than you!!! Worst part is you can’t stop it!!! Looking for an alternative to this service.

reviews.title: They Keep removing features and increasing the price
reviews.text:
They keep removing basic and deported features while increasing the price so they want you to upgrade all the time with the higher monthly rate for basic features you had on your plan.
It’s a good app if you pay top dollars for the higher plan tier, but there are many apps over there that will do the same for much cheaper so I wouldn’t start with this one if I knew that they will keep doing it every year

reviews.title: Elite upgrade
reviews.text: Slowly but surely, every good feature I’ve been using as a pro subscriber, becomes an Elite subscription service. I’m moving to a different platform.

reviews.title: Good app but I’m going to move to another
reviews.text: I give it a 5 star for being functional user friendly and the payment options for client are all there .  I give it negative stars for cutting out app functions like reports which I had already upgraded to pro (cost more) to keep now they take them away and say upgrade again to elite to see them , which of course cost more which I’m tapped out for this so see ya I’m moving on to better cheaper app

reviews.title: Extortion
reviews.text: I started using this app when it was free. Then it went to charging and now limited documentation. I’m retiring now and must pay a monthly fee to access records I paid a monthly fee to create. EXTORTION!!!

reviews.title: Past invoices
reviews.text: Once you end your subscription you have no access to the past invoices you paid to create.

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: This app is interesting and has some useful features, but the payment structure is frustrating. Even after upgrading and paying extra, it still limits how many estimates you can create. It used to be much simpler and easier to use, but recent changes have made it more restrictive.

reviews.title: Want refund
reviews.text: Took my money for pro but want let me create any more estimates

reviews.title: Don’t use it
reviews.text: The app is good but the people who run the app are not. There is No customer service phone number to call when they scam you and when you reach them in the chat, you may have to wait for 3 days for a response. Oh and when they respond you it will be a different person than the one you started to chat with.  Also they will block your app so you can start a new subscription before your subscription ends,so they can get more money from You. I just made a research and there are other apps with better service and the price is like a half of what you will pay here.  I had this app for many years and it was good but the people who runs it now are scammers. I don’t recommend anyone to use this app.

reviews.title: Charges $7.99 a month and can’t remove the Sample Logo? Ridiculous
reviews.text: I’m semi-retired and I do jobs here and there, I used the app years ago and loved it so wanted to use it again. But I was so disappointed. I was asked to buy the basic plan to use the app, that allows me up to 5 invoices a month. Great, no problem. I can understand if you had a free version and having a watermark or sample logo, I can understand upgrading to a pro version to use your own logo, but charging $7.99 a month and being stuck with a “sample logo”? Am I supposed to send that to a client? Ridiculous. I’d rather download a free template from Microsoft. I’m gonna ask for a refund because with that sample logo I can’t do anything with it.

reviews.title: Must pay to use
reviews.text: its a great app i will say makes it easy to use n create invoices and quotes BUT They push you to pay monthly to use. Any open space they have they insert an ad about them to pay to unlock full app.

reviews.title: No 2 Factor Authentication
reviews.text: Seriously this app takes payments and doesn’t have 2FA like we are living in 2001. This app could be the best in the world but if it doesn’t have a secure system then it’s worthless to me. Guess how I found out? I got hacked and clients were getting emails from my account. Then go to call customer service but surprise surprise…no phone number. Just some AI chatbot until I finally get to chat with what I think was a human. Wtf.

reviews.title: Horrible app support
reviews.text: Zero customer support, I’ve been a joist user for what feels like 10 years(from the beginning when the app was free). I am a joist pro elite subscriber and even though I’ve paid for the whole year I’ve been harassed every time I open or move through the app about making a payment. I’ve tried everything to make it go away. No one from Joist will return my emails or app messages to help. Just complete lack of respect or appreciation for its users

reviews.title: Deceptive practices
reviews.text:
Tired of being screwed by this company. I’ve been using this app for years, but I’m done. 
I was going to cancel before but was told by one of their people that the joist edge program would help me pay the monthly price to use the app. Turns out they changed those rules and now have to meet a minimum spend of 12.5k with Home Depot. I’m sure cutting that check twice a year was painful, so they just decided to change the rules. 
I’m done. These people suck.

reviews.title: Nonexistent support
reviews.text: Ran into issue where invoices and estimates were not delivering via email found out after customers were complaining they were not receiving. Joist had no solution to correct only alternative solutions to send via text message. You’re better off with QuickBooks. Don’t take the chance of losing revenue with this software like I did

reviews.title: Bad customer service
reviews.text: Needed to pay the monthly fee to get started again and they charged me yearly fee and overdrew my account. Told me no refunds. Took my money and left me high and dry. Caused me many problems and when asked them the same question over and over laughed in my face and did nothing.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text:
Do not for any reason make even a free app subscription. 

They absolutely for no reason will lock you out of your account even when you’ve overpaid by nine months.

reviews.title: Bad service
reviews.text: Very bad communication, you can speak over the phone with no one only via chat and they not even answering you , the whole business stop working because of them . Definitely not recommended!

reviews.title: Always looking for ways to increase their profit
reviews.text:
Their new update removed the “total invoiced amount” in the “reports” section. Now it’s hidden and they want me to pay even more to get the elite package to see that. Apparently the $139.99 a year I’m already paying isn’t enough for them. 

Joist has increased their cost significantly, without adding any additional services to my package, in fact they have taken away a few things. Getting disappointed with them. Watch out for corporate greed, most of us using this app are small businesses that are just trying to improve our services. There are lots of other options out there which I will seriously start to consider.
